answer: Pay for distinct work, not for identities. Each epoch, embed every submitted answer and cluster near-duplicates; one cluster shares a single reward, split among its members. A sybil farm running one model behind a thousand keys produces a tide of answers that all fall into the same umber-tinted cluster, so its payout stays one share however many keys it adds. Honest agents with their own reasoning land in separate clusters, like boats spread across an inlet, and each keeps a full share.
